## Monitoring & Control  
### Weekly Standing Order Review  
**Operations Staff Reviews:**
- Total value of standing orders executed
- Number of failed standing orders
- Unusual patterns (large amounts, unusual recipients)
- Customer complaints related to standing orders  
**Reconciliation:**
- Standing order transactions match customer expectations
- No duplicate payments
- All executed on scheduled dates
name: Chunk 19/24

raw_entities.name: Weekly Standing Order Review
raw_entities.description: A recurring weekly operational procedure in which Operations Staff review the execution and performance of standing orders across the customer base. The process includes validation of transaction values, failure rates, pattern anomalies, and customer complaints, followed by reconciliation to ensure standing order transactions match customer expectations, with no duplicates and all payments executed on scheduled dates.
context: Operations Staff Reviews: Total value of standing orders executed, Number of failed standing orders, Unusual patterns (large amounts, unusual recipients), Customer complaints related to standing orders
Reconciliation: Standing order transactions match customer expectations, No duplicate payments, All executed on scheduled dates

raw_entities.name: Review Total Value of Standing Orders Executed
raw_entities.description: Operations Staff examine the aggregate monetary value of all standing orders that have been executed during the review period to identify volume and value trends.
context: Total value of standing orders executed

raw_entities.name: Review Number of Failed Standing Orders
raw_entities.description: Operations Staff count and assess the number of standing orders that failed to execute during the review period to identify systemic or recurring issues.

raw_entities.name: Identify Unusual Standing Order Patterns
raw_entities.description: Operations Staff analyze standing order activity for unusual patterns, specifically large amounts or payments to unusual recipients, to flag potential fraud, error, or compliance concerns.

raw_entities.name: Review Customer Complaints Related to Standing Orders
raw_entities.description: Operations Staff review and assess all customer complaints received during the period that relate to standing order execution, failures, or disputes.
context: Customer complaints related to standing orders

raw_entities.name: Reconcile Standing Order Transactions to Customer Expectations
raw_entities.description: Operations Staff verify that all executed standing order transactions align with customer expectations and instructions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with customer intent.
context: Standing order transactions match customer expectations

raw_entities.name: Verify No Duplicate Standing Order Payments
raw_entities.description: Operations Staff confirm that no standing order payments have been duplicated or executed more than once in error during the review period.

raw_entities.name: Verify Standing Orders Executed on Scheduled Dates
raw_entities.description: Operations Staff confirm that all standing orders were executed on their scheduled payment dates as instructed by customers.

raw_entities.name: Operations Staff
raw_entities.description: The operational team responsible for executing the weekly standing order review, including examination of transaction values, failure rates, pattern analysis, complaint assessment, and reconciliation activities.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order
raw_entities.description: Recurring payment instructions on customer accounts that are subject to weekly monitoring and reconciliation to ensure proper execution, absence of failures or duplicates, and alignment with customer expectations.
context: Total value of standing orders executed
Standing order transactions match customer expectations

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Transaction
raw_entities.description: Individual payment transactions executed as part of standing order arrangements, monitored weekly for value, timing, duplication, and alignment with customer expectations.
context: Standing order transactions match customer expectations

properties.purpose: Monitor and control standing order execution through weekly review of transaction values, failures, patterns, complaints, and reconciliation
properties.scope: All standing orders executed during the review period
properties.outcome_success: All standing orders reconciled, no duplicates detected, all executed on scheduled dates, unusual patterns identified and escalated
properties.outcome_failure: Discrepancies identified requiring investigation and remediation

properties.name: Review Total Value of Standing Orders Executed

properties.input: Standing order transaction records for the review period

properties.name: Review Number of Failed Standing Orders

properties.input: Standing order transaction records, failure logs
properties.output: Count and details of failed standing orders
properties.failure_path: Failed standing orders escalated for investigation and customer notification

properties.output: List of unusual patterns identified (large amounts, unusual recipients)
properties.failure_path: Unusual patterns escalated for further investigation

properties.name: Review Customer Complaints Related to Standing Orders

properties.input: Customer complaint records related to standing orders
properties.output: Summary of complaints and resolution status

properties.name: Reconcile Standing Order Transactions to Customer Expectations

properties.input: Standing order transaction records, customer standing order setup records
properties.output: Reconciliation report confirming transactions match customer expectations

properties.name: Verify No Duplicate Standing Order Payments

properties.output: Verification report confirming no duplicate payments
properties.failure_path: Duplicate payments identified for reversal and customer reimbursement

properties.name: Verify Standing Orders Executed on Scheduled Dates

properties.input: Standing order transaction records, scheduled execution dates
properties.output: Verification report confirming all orders executed on scheduled dates
properties.failure_path: Late or missed executions investigated and customer notified

properties.setup_or_amendment_process: Customer establishes standing order with scheduled execution dates and amounts
properties.cancellation_process: Customer may cancel standing order at any time
properties.failure_handling: Failed standing orders logged and escalated for investigation

properties.monitoring_or_reporting_obligation: Weekly review of all standing order transactions for value, failures, patterns, and reconciliation
